text: After Theeb Rent A Car's March 2021 IPO on Tadawul, its largest shareholders were the founding Al-Theeb family members Hamoud Abdullah Al-Theeb and Mohammed Ahmed Abdullah Al-Theeb, with 23% each, and Growth Opportunities Company for Trading with 21%.
short: After its 2021 IPO, Theeb Rent A Car's largest shareholders were the founding Al-Theeb family members (23% each).

source.name: Argaam: Theeb Rent a Car shares debut on Tadawul today
source.quote: Hamoud Abdullah AlTheeb and Mohammed Ahmed Abdullah Al-Theeb are the largest shareholders following the IPO, with each holding 23% stake.
source.note: The same article's post-IPO table lists Hamoud Abdullah Al-Theeb 23.00%, Mohammed Ahmed Abdullah Al-Theeb 23.00%, Growth Opportunities Company for Trading 21.00%, remaining shareholders 3.00%, public 30.00%. The company grew out of Theeb Establishment for Contracting, owned by Hamoud Abdullah Al-Theeb, since 1991.
